lines.say: What if it started raining, and never stopped?
Day one. Puddles. You forgot your umbrella.
Day three. The street is a river. The bakery gives away wet bread.
Day seven. The water reaches the shop signs. School is cancelled. Forever.
Day thirty. The ground floor is gone. You live on the balcony now.
Day one hundred. Your neighbour paddles past in a bathtub.
One year. Only the roof is left. Fish swim past your window.
Then the rain stops. The sun comes out.
And your boss emails. See you Monday.
Would you stay? Yes or no?
